name: old-tv-1
_beats: Episode old-tv, 'An old TV in thirty seconds': Analog Signal Lab and its four presets on the opera house clip.
Part 1 (old-tv-1): the result first (Tube Television, playing), the intro, the joke, then the effect is removed: start from scratch.
Part 2 (old-tv-2): select the clip, Properties, Effects, + Add Effect, type analog, Analog Signal Lab; it starts as a broadcast.
Part 3 (old-tv-3): the Preset menu: Snowy Reception, Worn VHS, Tube Television, Rolling Picture; the sign-off.

scenes.say: [upbeat] Hey, what's up, Dominik Flamer here, and today: an old TV... in thirty seconds. [deadpan] The intro doesn't count.
[proudly] This is a brand new opera house. [deadpan] Broadcast live... from nineteen eighty-three.
[snaps back to upbeat] Okay! So let's build it from scratch.
